verdict.rationale: Helicone's Sessions feature groups related requests so you can trace an entire agent flow in one unified view. Path syntax expresses parent-child relationships, giving nested, hierarchical traces, and the GitHub README lists sessions and traces as first-class UI concepts. A LangChain user also reported that Helicone helped them debug long chains and runaway agents. missing for 10: evidence of span-level instrumentation beyond LLM requests (e.g., tool or non-LLM steps as spans), thread/conversation grouping semantics, independent hands-on corroboration of the Sessions/nesting feature specifically
